contradicting_evidence: Broad positive returns and participation could persist long enough to produce an upward trend rather than an indecisive path.
The latest $526.7 million BTC ETF inflow is meaningful positive evidence and should not be described as continuing BTC outflows.
Conversely, falling ETH/BTC and negative settled ETH flows could resolve the uncertainty toward renewed weakness.
Positive funding and long/short ratios above one leave some vulnerability if price support fails, although the supplied readings do not establish extreme crowding.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: The next three days are more likely to test whether the broad daily rebound can persist than to deliver an already-established directional continuation. BTC-specific support and current alt participation compete with weak ETH-relative follow-through and unconfirmed liquidity deployment. There is insufficient evidence to favor a net upward or downward outcome reliably.
falsification_conditions: Persistent gains in BTC and ETH, improving ETH/BTC, sustained breadth and better settled ETH flows would establish an upward edge and invalidate the no-edge assessment.
Repeated recovery failures accompanied by broader declines, continued ETH/BTC weakness and worsening settled demand would establish a downward edge.
If positive proxy participation survives several observations while spot demand strengthens, the present concern about transient breadth would weaken.
missing_evidence: Subsequent settled ETF sessions showing whether BTC inflows persist and ETH outflows improve or worsen.
Repeated breadth observations establishing persistence rather than a single broad 24h rebound.
A price-and-open-interest sequence distinguishing sustained demand from position reduction or short covering.
supporting_evidence: The strongest constructive signal is current broad participation, while the latest hourly ETH/BTC signal points the other way.
BTC and ETH ETF flows diverge materially, preventing BTC demand from being generalized to the wider market.
Stablecoin supply declined approximately 0.77% over seven days, with deployment confirmation explicitly NOT_ESTABLISHED.
Large- and mid-alt proxies outperform BTC broadly on the current 24h window, but canonical breadth remains unconfirmed and persistence is unknown.
